test_inputs.explanation: The agent executed a successful workflow on a GitLab instance at http://172.26.116.102:8080. The execution involved multiple authentication attempts (sign_in pages), navigation to /explore and /users endpoints, and password reset flows. Based on the tool's schema for creating GitLab projects and the agent's successful navigation through authentication-protected endpoints, I've inferred realistic test values that would work with this GitLab instance. The values include a generic project name and slug, a descriptive description, 'private' visibility (common for test projects), and README initialization enabled.
